title: 下載版本與設定頁版本一致
summary: 更新後可直接對照下載檔名與「關於與支援」的版本，確認目前執行的是哪一版 SnapBar。
highlights: 官網與設定頁顯示相同版本，並清楚標示預覽版、正式版或開發版。
發布前核對套件內程式的版本與來源，避免檔名和實際內容不同。
診斷區保留完整版本資訊，方便回報問題。
usage: 先從系統匣正常結束舊版，將新 ZIP 完整解壓縮到新的資料夾並執行 SnapBar.App.exe，再到設定的「關於與支援」對照下載版本；原有個人設定會沿用。

en.title: Match your running version to your download
en.summary: Match the version in About & Support to your download and confirm which SnapBar build is running.
highlights: The website and settings show the same version and identify preview, stable and development builds.
Release checks verify the packaged application's version and source before publication.
Diagnostics retain the full build information for support requests.
en.usage: Quit the old version from the system tray, extract the new ZIP to a new folder, and run SnapBar.App.exe. Open Settings > About & Support to compare versions. Your personal settings are kept.
